messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: several interviewers didn't get their "training completion" badge after the LMS webhook rollout this morning. Diego noticed missing flags on the panel roster. Anyone else seeing this?

Diego (Recruiting Ops): Yep. Panel for ENG-4 on Friday shows 4/6 completed in LMS, but our scorecard UI says 0/6. That blocks auto-enable of live scoring.

lms-bot: Webhook delivered: 2026-03-22T09:12:03Z status=200 id=wh_8a7f

Sam (Talent Systems): I'm looking. The new LMS payload changed "completed_courses" -> "courses_completed" and also wrapped instructor metadata in "meta". Our listener still expects the old shape.

Riley (Hiring Manager): Is this why my interviewers got a generic "complete training" email but no badge? :confused: We have ramp interviews next week.

Maya (People Ops): Correct. We need a quick fix so scorecards flip to editable for certified interviewers. Diego, can you list affected panels so we can postpone anything at risk?

Diego (Recruiting Ops): I'll dump panels where scorecard_editable=false but LMS shows any course completion. Ran a quick query: panels ENG-4 (IDs P-8802,P-8803), DATA-1 (P-9101).

Sam (Talent Systems): Proposed short-term fix: update the webhook adapter to accept both keys and normalize at ingestion. I'll open PR. Quick patch snippet I'm testing locally:

```python
# in integrations/lms/webhook_handler.py
payload = request.json
completed = payload.get("courses_completed") or payload.get("completed_courses") or []
# normalize instructor meta
if "meta" in payload:
    payload.update(payload.pop("meta"))
```

Sam (Talent Systems): I'll also add a unit test in CI asserting both shapes map to InterviewerCertification events.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: integrations-lms-fix -> staging. Triggered by Sam.

Maya (People Ops): Diego, can you hold off sending training reminder nudges until we confirm the backfill? Don't want duplicate emails.

Diego (Recruiting Ops): Will pause nudges. Also, suggest a one-off backfill to mark scorecards editable using LMS user IDs we already have. Command we can run: `python tools/mark_scorecards.py --from-lms --dry-run`

Riley (Hiring Manager): Appreciate it. If we need to push any interviewers to a manual onboarding task, tell me and I'll reassign.

Sam (Talent Systems): Staging looks good for the adapter. I'll run the backfill dry-run and paste the delta here in 10m.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks. After we patch and backfill, let's add a post-deploy checklist step: verify LMS webhook event shape and run the unit test matrix against both old/new payloads. Also log this as RISK item in recruitment runbook.

Diego (Recruiting Ops): Confirmed: dry-run shows 9 scorecards that would flip -> editable. I'll message those hiring managers with the list once you give greenlight.

Sam (Talent Systems): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/integrations/pulls/458 (patch + tests). Canary deploying to prod in 30m if no issues in staging.

Maya (People Ops): Great. Leave a note in the hiring calendar for next week's panels noting the temporary manual-check step. Closing loop once ops-bot reports prod deploy. :white_check_mark:
